{{Top|leg}}
'''Lettranin''' was a sport played on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Keedad]]. It was similar to [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] in that the players used [[Lettranin scoop|large scoops]] to propel a spiked seed pod taken from [[lettrani fruit tree]]s. It was played in an enclosed [[Stone/Legends|stone]] arena and points were awarded for scoring goals and incapacitating members of the opposing team.
